name: dumbbell reverse grip row (female)
description: A bent-over dumbbell row using an underhand grip. Trains the upper back and biceps.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip, palms facing forward.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees, arms hanging straight.
Row the dumbbells toward your hips, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
